name: Matthias Barr
bio: Matthias Barr (1831–1911) was born in Edinburgh, the son of a German-born watchmaker, and educated at the High School and Academy there. After a visit to Germany he settled in London, where he held a post and later kept a music-selling and publishing business.

His first volume of verse appeared in 1865, followed by several short collections of simple lyrics and verses for children. Two of his nursery poems, “Moon, so round and yellow” and “Only a baby small”, were widely reprinted.

poems.title: Moon, So Round and Yellow
poems.author: Matthias Barr
poems.text:
Moon, so round and yellow,
    Looking from on high,
How I love to see you
    Shining in the sky.
Oft and oft I wonder,
    When I see you there,
How they get to light you,
    Hanging in the air:

Where you go at morning,
    When the night is past,
And the sun comes peeping
    O'er the hills at last.
Sometime I will watch you
    Slyly overhead,
When you think I'm sleeping
    Snugly in my bed.

poems.title: Only a Baby Small
poems.author: Matthias Barr
